interpretation: Fixed three-arm, matched-allocation diagnostic. Strict primary acceptance and post-hoc barrier full-family validation are separate; original native flags/times remain unchanged. Censors and failures are retained. This is a combined persistent-model/basis implementation comparison, not isolated causal attribution to model construction or warm starts.

measurement_scope.algorithm_stop: Construction through returned optimization/pricing stop, including intermediate RMP replay; before final full-family validation
measurement_scope.process_memory: Cumulative ru_maxrss per fresh worker, separately sampled at algorithm stop and after in-worker diagnostics; excludes later independent replay/analysis processes
measurement_scope.cg_poststop_memory: Full graph can be materialized only for final certification; budget failures may not complete this step
measurement_scope.solver_memory: Separate Gurobi allocation measure; not total process RSS, with per-RMP versus persistent-environment scopes retained in raw results
measurement_scope.model_size: Fixed L15 map, T48 horizon and 0.5 SoC grid; task count changes task arcs, coverage rows and original seed variables. Large task-independent graph terms remain. Inputs at different task counts are independent rather than nested draws; no inference about arbitrary horizon/map/grid scaling.
